{InvalidPath}: Invalid folder. Select your Mayhem installation folder.
{InvalidSaveFolder}: Select the X3 save folder. Its name must end with 'save'.
{Tips.BtnGenerateSystems}: Generate a new galaxy using the selected settings.
{Tips.BtnGenerateGates}: Regenerate gates while preserving territory rules. Keep the current network if no valid replacement is found.
{Tips.BtnGenerateStats}: Reroll sector stats using this galaxy’s stored modifier. Generate a new galaxy to use a different modifier.
{Tips.BtnX3Save}: Select the folder containing your X3 saved games.
{Tips.SectorCount}: Double-click a void to add a sector, or right-click a cell to add or remove one. Allowed: {0}–{1}.
{Map.Valid}: VALID: Required unknown enclaves present; all sectors connected.
{Tips.VoidSlider}: Target percentage of empty cells. The sector count stays within the selected galaxy size limits.
{Tips.CbClusteredXenon}: Grow connected Xenon territories from dead ends. Standard allows multiple clusters; Chaotic uses one.
{Tips.CbLimitedEnclaves}: Reduce optional dead ends. Keep at least two unknown enclaves in Chaotic, four otherwise, and a Xenon starting enclave.
{Tips.GbExpansion}: Unknown space is a percentage of non-Xenon sectors, rounded up. Races receive the remainder. Origin gives each race one sector.
{Tips.GbSystemSpread}: Adjust each race’s share of owned sectors. Higher values give a race more sectors; equal values cancel out.
{Tips.GbGalaxySize}: Sector limits: Small 50–85, Medium 86–144, and Large 145–246.
{Tips.GbGateDensity}: Set gate density before assigning territories. Low removes more gates; connectivity and required enclaves are preserved.
{Tips.GbMapType}: Choose a square or rectangular map.
{Tips.GbMusic}:
Choose the sector music source:
Basic: \mayhem_data\custom_musics.txt
Litcube: \mayhem_data\custom_musics_lu.txt
All: \soundtrack folder
Custom: selected music folder
{Tips.GbRelations}: Set permanent friend or foe relations between races at game start.
{Tips.cbChaotic}: Xenon start with 50% of all sectors, rounded up, in one connected territory. The game chooses Maelstrom’s location unless you set an override.
{Tips.cbPeaceful}: Create exactly one Xenon sector. The game handles Maelstrom placement unless you set an override.
{Tips.btnShowSectorStats}: Show population and station support on the galaxy map.
{Tips.btnShowSectorNames}: Show sector names on the galaxy map.
{Tips.btnLaunchWeaponsEditor}: Randomize ship and weapon stats by race or weapon group.
{Tips.btnConfig}: Edit Mayhem settings in t-files 9972 and 9973.
{Tips.edit9972}: Edit Mayhem settings in the 9972 t-file.
{Tips.edit9973}: Edit Zero Hour and Renegades settings in the 9973 t-file.
{Tips.txtFindSector}: Find a sector by full or partial name. Enter: next match. Shift+Enter: previous match.
{Tips.btnFindNext}: Go to the next matching sector.
{Tips.btnExportPng}: Save the complete galaxy map as a PNG image.

Edit.Invalid: This edit would invalidate the galaxy
Edit.Disconnected: All sectors must remain connected by gates.
Edit.Gates: Gates must have valid reciprocal destinations and use each direction at most once.
Edit.Seeds: Each race must keep its protected territory seed and ownership.
Edit.Portal: Choose at most one Maelstrom override, in a Xenon sector, or clear it to let the game choose.
Edit.Protected: Protected territory seeds cannot be removed or reassigned.
Edit.Budget: The proposed ownership does not match the required sector counts.
Edit.Enclaves: Keep at least two unknown dead ends in Chaotic galaxies, or four in Standard and Peaceful galaxies.
Edit.Spacing: Territory seeds must stay at least four gate jumps apart.
Edit.Territory: Each race must have one connected territory. Transfers to a race must border its existing territory.
Edit.Exit: Every race territory must retain a gate to unknown space.
Edit.Border: Different main-race territories must be separated by unknown or Xenon space.
Edit.Xenon: Chaotic Xenon must remain connected. Each clustered Xenon group must include a dead end.
Edit.Legacy: This map has no recorded territory seeds. Generate a new galaxy to edit ownership or gates, or add or remove sectors. Stats and music remain editable.
Edit.Count: This change would exceed the galaxy size range or the 15–50% void limits.

Edit.MinimumXenon: Xenon count must be between the rounded-up target and one sector above it (50% target for Chaotic). The range uses the total sectors after this edit.
Randomizer.WeaponsNote: Each weapon group shares separate hull damage, shield damage, firing rate, range, and speed rolls. Production averages damage, rate, and range. Lifetime compensates for speed. Energy, Repair Laser, Mobile Drilling System, and Mounted Railgun stay unchanged.
Randomizer.ShipsNote: Each race shares separate speed, acceleration, turning, shield generator, hull, and cargo rolls. Shields follow the generator roll, rounded within class limits. Production: movement 40%, durability 40%, and cargo 20%. TL cargo and weapon energy stay unchanged.
Randomizer.RaceNote: Reroll this race from bundled defaults; keep other races’ overrides. Shields follow the generator roll, rounded within class limits. Production: movement 40%, durability 40%, and cargo 20%. TL cargo and weapon energy stay unchanged.
